note: The cleanest core-ICP match in this batch and one of the clearest in the corpus. Successful: 20 years at an airline, an FAA licence he paid for out of pocket, moving into the role he has wanted for two decades. Income: $146,000 today, savings, and a credit card he has never carried a balance on in ten years — the only qualification is that it falls to $100,000 with the new role, which changed his payment method but not his willingness. Neglected_health: health is explicitly not a crisis; "I'm already, for my age and in my office, like, one of the most fit, healthy people around." Good_to_great is close to verbatim on both sides — the prospect said "I just want to get that extra edge, you know, that extra 5% to 10% less body fat", and when the rep said "Like we said, we're getting from good to great" he answered "That's it. That's it." Not_deconditioned: he was significantly overweight 10-15 years ago and has already resolved it himself, trains consistently in a home gym and is at home with fasting protocols — the exclusion is about the current starting point and he is nowhere near it. Worth recording for the wider comparison: this is what the stated ICP describes, he closed at full price in 51 minutes, and the rep still skipped past-attempts, root-cause and the entire consequence frame. A core-ICP prospect appears to close almost regardless of process, which is the mirror image of the Robyn Stillwater finding and should be weighed alongside it.
